hero.title: Every document, signed and sealed under EU law
hero.subtitle: The enterprise e-signature portal with PAdES cryptographic sealing, RFC 3161 timestamps and an audit trail built for review.
hero.caption: The StålFe demo workspace replayed end to end: a mill certificate goes to the foundry, is signed, sealed and proven with cryptographic evidence.

trust.summary: EU data residency. GDPR, eIDAS-aligned and 21 CFR Part 11 workflows. Public status at status.docurama.eu, platform security at security.docurama.eu.

features.bentoTitle: A complete evidence pipeline, not just a signature in a corner
features.bentoSubtitle: Docurama binds identity, document bytes and cryptographic time into a single PAdES-sealed PDF that verifies offline without calling our servers.
features.sendAndSignDesc: Multi-signer envelopes with routing order, carbon copies and reminders. Signers never need an account.
features.certsAndSealingDesc: One-click RSA-2048 signing certificates per workspace. Seal with PAdES conformance from B-B to B-LTA.
features.timestampsDesc: Every signature anchored to an independent Timestamp Authority. Presets for DigiCert, Sectigo, GlobalSign, or your own TSA.

pricing.title: Predictable pricing with no envelope surprise bills
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes unlimited signers, live verification and certificate management. Upgrade when you need higher volumes or regulated compliance modes.
pricing.starterBlurb: For small teams sending their first envelopes.
pricing.businessBlurb: For growing operations that live in documents.
pricing.enterpriseBlurb: For regulated teams with audit obligations.

compliance.title: Built for regulated European enterprises
compliance.subtitle: Docurama SAS is governed by French and EU law. We never transfer your documents across borders.
